title: OJCP Registry Entry
description: One listed OJCP provider. One file per provider at providers/<domain>.json.

domain.description: The provider's primary domain (host only, no scheme or path). Must match the filename.

name.description: Human-readable provider name (from the manifest's provider.name).

manifest_url.description: URL of the provider's OJCP manifest. MUST be https://<domain>/.well-known/ojcp.json.

trust_tier.description: Registry trust tier. New listings start at 'unverified'. Promotion follows the spec's Registry Trust Tiers and is granted by reviewed PR.

manifest_signed.description: Whether the provider's manifest carries a valid signature at listing time.

domain_control.description: How control of the domain was proven before listing.

method.description: 'signed_manifest' = the manifest's signature validated against a key served on the domain. 'dns_txt' = an ojcp-registry-verification TXT record was present.

industries.description: Optional industry tags for find_ojcp_providers filtering.

has_agent_apply.description: Whether any apply_path supports agent submission.

attestations.description: Third-party legitimacy attestations (decentralization hook — empty during bootstrap; future issuers e.g. ATS vendors, KYB providers).

tier_history.description: Append-only log of tier changes (git history is the primary audit trail; this mirrors it in-record).
